messages:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — we're putting together a lightweight certification gate for partner terraform modules that want to ship via cloud marketplaces. Goal: automated checks + a small manual QA signoff.
Devon: nice. scope? only terraform modules or also sample apps + deployment manifests?
Olivia: start with modules + marketplace manifest (the template buyers install). sample apps are next phase.
Sam: we'll need a concrete checklist otherwise every partner ships different stuff. can we define a PR linter + smoke test matrix?
Olivia: yes — proposed checks: 1) module lint (tfsec/tflint), 2) manifest schema validation, 3) idempotent apply smoke (1min), 4) minimal cost resource cap, 5) metadata for marketplace (owner, support link, version)
Nate: for smoke tests, can we run them against a small sandbox account (spot instances / smallest sizes)? I can own the harness.
Devon: +1. also include a quick terraform init/plan check with provider pinning enforcement. surprises come from implicit provider versions.
Kevin: can we add a compatibility matrix field to the manifest: supported regions, arch (x86/arm), supported infra (gke/eks/oci), quantized model size hints? marketplace teams ask for that.
Rachel: from partner side — they'll want a checklist template and a CI config they can copy. please keep it easy to adopt.
Olivia: agreed. I'm drafting a repo scaffold and example PR. sketch of the manifest (ideas):

```yaml
name: my-llm-accelerator
version: 1.0.0
supported_architectures: ["x86_64", "arm64"]
cloud_compat: ["aws-us-east-1", "gcp-europe-west1"]
module_entry: modules/marketplace
support_contact: support@example.com
quality_badges: []
```

Sam: looks good. we should enforce a small `metadata.yaml` in root for automation so we don't parse tf files.
Devon: for the linter, recommend tflint + a custom rule set for resource tagging and cost caps. I can prototype the rules.
Nate: QA harness notes: smoke test should include `terraform apply` with `-auto-approve` in an ephemeral workspace, validate endpoints respond on port 8080 (if web sample), then `terraform destroy`. Failure -> block. Timebox 10m.
Olivia: action items: Devon to prototype linter rules; Sam to draft sample repo scaffold + example module; Nate to create smoke test harness; Kevin to propose manifest schema additions. I'll assemble the README and checklist.
Sam: volunteer: I'll create the scaffold this week. will include a sample `marketplace.yaml` and a CI workflow (GitHub Actions) that runs tfsec/tflint/plan/smoke.
Devon: I'll drop a tflint ruleset PR by EOD Friday.
Nate: I'll sketch the harness repo (containerized runner) and will wire it into CI that uses a Redwood sandbox account.
Kevin: will add region/arch matrix and a short blurb on recommended instance families (arm64-friendly, gpu families).
Rachel: partner ask — can the badge reflect a "marketplace-certified" status? that helps partners market their packages.
Olivia: yes, if module passes automated checks + one manual signoff from Partner Eng (Sam)/Solutions (Kevin), we issue a certification badge and add them to the accelerator catalog.
DeployBot: deployment-candidate created: pr #412 for partners/scaffold-template (olivia)
CI Bot: github/actions — initial workflow queued: tflint, tfsec, terraform-plan — running
Sam: heads-up, include a small snippet in README showing how to reference the module: 

```hcl
module "redwood_marketplace_example" {
  source  = "./modules/marketplace-starter"
  version = "v1.2.0"
  marketplace_manifest = file("marketplace.yaml")
}
```

Devon: one more thing — enforce `provider` version pinning and recommend `required_providers` block. else plan diffs on cloud side.
Nate: test matrix: linux runners only for now; arm runner later. also add a flaky test tracker so partners can address intermittent failures.
Olivia: timeline: scaffold + rules + harness MVP this sprint (2 weeks). after that we invite 2 partners for pilot.
Rachel: I'll coordinate partner pilot invites — two partners agreed to test next week. sending calendar invites after scaffold lands. :tada:
Sam: thanks all — will post PR link when scaffold is up.
Olivia: perfect. if anyone has objections or wants to lead a piece, ping me. otherwise I'll run the checklist doc and track tasks in the partnership board. :thumbsup:
